personality_one_liner: A structured, highly readable, and trustworthy mobile ERP where data clarity and rapid RTL text entry reign supreme.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. Always account for Safe Area at screen root. Cards should never be flush to the edge.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bars, sticky headers over scrolling content, and floating action buttons.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (≥70% opacity of surface) underneath to guarantee readability.
dont's: Never blur body text regions, form fields, or cards in dense data lists.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry via Google Sign-In or Activation Code.

states.error: Toast or inline alert indicating invalid license or failed login.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top (abstract business shape or logistics warehouse), followed by a clean, single-column form taking up the lower half. Primary CTA sticky at bottom.

screens.name: Owner Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of products, customers, inventory, and KPIs.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty warehouse with 'No data generated yet' + Add Employee/Product CTA.
states.error: Readable message with a prominent 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Grid of KPI cards at the top using abstract subtle gradients. Below, horizontal scrollable lists for quick access to Distributors and Recent Transactions.

screens.name: Invoice Creation (Distributor)
screens.purpose: Create a new sales invoice with dynamic line items in the field.

states.error: Form validation errors highlighted in red (e.g., missing quantities).

screens.layout: Modular form. Section 1: Customer details. Section 2: Dynamic list of line items (description, quantity, price fields stacked vertically or in neat cards per item). An 'Add Item' button explicitly beneath the list. Section 3: Totals summary. The 'Submit Invoice' primary CTA must be sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Accountant Sales & Debts
screens.purpose: Track sales invoices, collections, and outstanding customer debts.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean ledger, 'No outstanding debts'.

screens.layout: Tabbed view or segmented control for filtering [Invoices | Collections | Debts]. Detailed list rows with high contrast text for monetary values. Prominent search bar at the top.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Arabic RTL Compliance. Do not use 'marginLeft' or 'paddingRight'. Use logical properties strictly ('marginStart', 'paddingEnd'). Initialize React Native I18nManager to force RTL (I18nManager.forceRTL(true)) upon app launch.

CRITICAL: Arabic Typography. The font sizes have been scaled up by ~2px compared to default Latin scales. DO NOT apply any 'letterSpacing' (tracking) to text. Arabic is a cursive script; letter spacing disconnects the letters and breaks the text.
For numbers (like prices and phone numbers), stick to standard Western Arabic numerals (0-9) unless the locale requires Eastern Arabic numerals, but make sure they align correctly in RTL.

Invoice Creation Form: Break this into logical chunks per Mobbin patterns. Customer selection should be distinct from the dynamic line items array. Stack the line item inputs (Description, Qty, Price) inside a 'surfaceSecondary' card for easy touch targets in the field.
Ensure every screen with scrolling content and a core action (e.g. Save Invoice) has a sticky CTA at the bottom, placed inside a Safe Area avoiding container outside the ScrollView.
When rendering images as backgrounds (e.g. Owner Dashboard Header), you MUST apply the top-to-bottom gradient scrim using 'expo-linear-gradient' to ensure text contrast for Arabic text placed on it.
